title.zh: 孟子 · 仁政如何可能

summary.en: Mencius carried a demanding question into the courts of the Warring States: what would government look like if rulers began with people's needs? In the dialogues associated with him, secure livelihoods make moral conduct possible, while conquest and display offer no substitute for care. His account of human nature starts from capacities for compassion and judgment that require cultivation, rather than from a claim that everyone already behaves well. The book also preserves frustration: rulers listened without necessarily changing their policies. Its conversations were collected and shaped by later followers. Reading them alongside Qin's reforms reveals competing answers to the same problem—how to establish order in a world of rival states.
summary.zh: 孟子走入战国诸侯的宫廷，提出一个要求很高的问题：如果君主从百姓的生活出发，政治应当怎样运作？《孟子》中的对话把稳定的生计视为践行道德的条件，认为征服和炫耀不能代替对人的照顾。他讨论人性时，强调恻隐与判断能力需要培育，并不是说人人已经行为良善。书中也保留了劝说的挫折：君主愿意听，并不意味着愿意改变政策。这些对话由后学整理而成。把它与秦国变法并读，可以看到面对列国竞争，思想家提出了怎样不同的秩序方案。

title.en: Shang Yang · Remaking the Qin state
title.zh: 商鞅 · 重塑秦国制度

location.label: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

labelI18n.en: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

summary.en: Shang Yang's reforms made farming, military service and official rewards parts of a single political project. The Shiji describes households registered in groups, rewards for military achievement, pressure to divide large families, and penalties that reached beyond an individual offender. County officials and common measures strengthened the court's reach into local life. These changes challenged hereditary privilege while imposing new forms of coercion. Their author did not enjoy lasting protection: after Duke Xiao died, his opponents pursued and killed him. The Book of Lord Shang developed related arguments over several generations. It is evidence for a tradition of statecraft, not a transcript of everything Shang Yang personally believed or enacted.
summary.zh: 商鞅把农业、军役和官府赏罚纳入同一个政治方案。《史记》记述了编户连坐、按军功授爵、促使大家庭分户，以及牵连个人以外的严厉刑罚。设置县官、统一度量，也让国君更直接地介入地方生活。这些措施冲击世袭特权，同时建立了新的强制机制。变法者本人并未获得持久保护：秦孝公死后，政敌追捕并杀死了他。与其相关的《商君书》经过几代人的形成，反映的是一种治国思想传统，不能把全书都当作商鞅个人言行的实录。

dateNote.en: Focus: the conventional reform period, 356–338 BCE; 350 BCE marks the Xianyang and county-administration measures. Regnal chronology is read with Shiji chapters 5 and 68. No inherited birth year is retained.
dateNote.zh: 重点为通常所定的前356—前338年变法时期；前350年对应迁都咸阳与县制措施。纪年结合《史记》卷五、卷六十八，不沿用未经核实的出生年。

title.en: Sun Bin · Strategy and the stories of victory
title.zh: 孙膑 · 兵法与胜利的叙事

summary.en: Sun Bin appears in the Shiji as a strategist serving Qi after suffering mutilation in the rival state of Wei. Working with Tian Ji, he redirects attention from a besieged ally toward the enemy's vulnerable home territory. The battles of Guiling and Maling became celebrated examples of anticipation and deception. Their surviving accounts differ, however, in what happened to the opposing commander Pang Juan. Bamboo manuscripts excavated at Yinqueshan in 1972 restored a military text associated with Sun Bin and made those differences visible. His story therefore connects two kinds of historical work: examining how armies fought and asking how later writers turned a campaign into an exemplary lesson.
summary.zh: 《史记》中的孙膑先在魏国遭受膑刑，后来为齐国谋划战事。他与田忌合作，把行动的重点从救援受围的盟国，转向敌国本土的弱处。桂陵和马陵之战因而成为预判与用计的著名故事。不过，传世记述对对手庞涓的遭遇并不完全一致。1972年，银雀山出土的竹简使与孙膑有关的兵书重新进入研究视野，也显露了不同叙事之间的差别。他的经历连接着两种历史问题：军队如何作战，后来的作者又如何把一次战役写成可供学习的范例。

title.en: Qu Yuan · A voice preserved in poetry
title.zh: 屈原 · 诗歌保存的声音

location.label: Miluo region, associated with Qu Yuan’s received biography

labelI18n.en: Miluo region, associated with Qu Yuan’s received biography
labelI18n.zh: 传世屈原生平所关联的汨罗地区

summary.en: Qu Yuan's historical voice reaches us through poems and through a biography written much later. The Shiji presents a Chu courtier whose advice was displaced by rivals and whose exile sharpened his criticism of political failure. Poems associated with him in the Songs of Chu use journeys, fragrant plants and encounters with the divine to explore loyalty, estrangement and frustrated ambition. This is a literary world as well as a political one; its speakers cannot simply be converted into a day-by-day life. Later commemoration, including Dragon Boat Festival traditions, made Qu Yuan a figure through whom readers debated service, integrity and belonging. The atlas separates that enduring reception from the uncertain detail of his lifetime.
summary.zh: 屈原的声音通过诗篇，以及写成于更晚时期的传记流传下来。《史记》把他描写为楚国朝臣：意见被排挤，放逐又加深了他对政治失败的批评。《楚辞》中与他相联系的作品，以远游、香草和神灵相遇等意象，讨论忠诚、疏离与难以实现的抱负。这既是政治世界，也是文学世界，不能把诗中的叙述者逐句转换成日常生平。后来包括端午节在内的纪念传统，使读者不断借屈原思考出仕、操守与归属。图集将这种持久的接受史，与其生前难以确定的细节区分呈现。

dateNote.en: Focus: the early third century BCE and the traditional death date of 278 BCE. The exact lifespan and attribution of individual poems remain uncertain; 278 is marked approximate, not independently established by Shiji chapter 84.
dateNote.zh: 重点为公元前三世纪初及传统的前278年卒年。精确生卒年与部分诗作归属未定；前278年标为约年，并非《史记》卷八十四独立确定的日期。

title.en: Bai Qi · Conquest and its human cost
title.zh: 白起 · 征服及其代价

location.label: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

labelI18n.en: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

summary.en: Bai Qi helped turn Qin's military strength into territorial expansion. The Shiji follows him from victories against Han and Wei to the capture of Chu's capital, Ying, and the defeat of Zhao at Changping. These were campaigns that damaged rival states' ability to resist Qin, but their history also includes the killing of surrendered soldiers. Ancient casualty totals are not dependable counts; the violence itself remains central to the account. Bai Qi's final conflict was with his own court. He resisted another attack on Zhao, lost royal favor and was ordered to die. His career shows the insecurity of a commander whose victories increased both the ruler's power and dependence on him.
summary.zh: 白起把秦国的军事力量转化为领土扩张。《史记》记载他击败韩、魏，攻取楚都郢，又在长平击败赵军。这些战役削弱了诸侯抵抗秦国的能力，其中也包括对投降士卒的杀戮。古书中的伤亡数字不能当作可靠统计，但暴力本身不能从叙述中删去。白起最后面对的冲突来自本国宫廷。他反对继续进攻赵国，随后失去君主信任，被命令自尽。他的经历说明：将领的胜利既增强国君权势，也可能让双方的依赖与猜忌同时加深。

dateNote.en: Focus: the documented command sequence from Yique (293 BCE) to Bai Qi’s death (conventionally 257 BCE). Civil years follow the Qin regnal chronology; birth is not supplied.

description.zh: 击败韩魏增强了秦国向东发展的军事地位。

description.zh: 据《史记》记述，赵军战败后，大批降卒遭到杀害。

title.en: Li Mu · Protecting a state under pressure
title.zh: 李牧 · 守护危局中的赵国

summary.en: Li Mu's biography begins with a different image of military skill: keeping soldiers and herds safe by refusing unnecessary battle. On Zhao's northern frontier, the Shiji credits him with disciplined defenses, attention to supplies and training, and protection of agriculture and pastoral life. Later he fought Yan and helped resist Qin as Zhao's position deteriorated. The same narrative explains his removal through court intrigue and Qin's bribery of a royal favorite. That account exposes the historian's interest in the relationship between rulers and capable servants, as well as recording Zhao's crisis. Li Mu was killed before the final capture of Zhao's king. His unknown birth date and the undated frontier anecdotes should not become a fabricated itinerary.
summary.zh: 李牧传记开篇呈现了另一种军事能力：通过避免无谓交战，保护士卒与牲畜。《史记》称他在赵国北部边地整顿防御，重视供给、训练，并维护农牧生产。后来他攻燕，又在赵国局势恶化时抵御秦军。同一传记用宫廷离间和秦国贿赂宠臣来解释他的被罢免；这既记录赵国危机，也表现史家对君臣关系的关注。李牧在赵王最终被俘之前遭杀害。他的出生年不详，北疆故事也缺少确切年份，不能把这些材料拼成看似完整的行程。

dateNote.en: Focus: the Yan campaign conventionally dated 243 BCE through the removal and death in 229 BCE. Earlier northern service is undated. The Zhao annals and biography use regnal years; campaign accounts are not identical in every chapter.
dateNote.zh: 重点为通常系于前243年的攻燕至前229年的罢免与被杀。更早的北疆任职没有确切日期。《赵世家》与列传采用在位年纪年，不同篇章的战役记述并非全同。

description.zh: 赵国一系记述称李牧击退秦军，其他本纪的叙事重点有所不同。

description.en: Li Mu was replaced and killed while Qin’s invasion threatened Zhao’s survival.
description.zh: 秦军入侵危及赵国存续时，李牧被撤换并杀害。

title.en: Wang Jian · The resources behind conquest
title.zh: 王翦 · 征服背后的资源

location.label: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

labelI18n.en: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

summary.en: Wang Jian commanded several of the campaigns that brought Qin's rivals under imperial rule. His biography makes victory depend on resources and political trust as much as battlefield daring. In the account of the Chu campaign, a smaller expedition failed before the king accepted Wang Jian's demand for a much larger force. The general then delayed battle while preparing his army. Stories about his repeated requests for estates underline the tension between a ruler and a commander entrusted with enormous power. He also campaigned against Zhao and Yan. Distinguishing Wang Jian from his son Wang Ben matters: later summaries can collapse different commanders and campaigns into one effortless march toward unification.
summary.zh: 王翦统率了秦兼并诸侯过程中的多次重要战役。他的传记把胜利与资源、政治信任联系起来，并不只强调临阵勇武。伐楚的叙事先写较小规模的远征失败，随后秦王才接受王翦增兵的要求；王翦又通过等待和准备选择作战时机。他反复请求田宅的故事，表现了国君与掌握大军的将领之间的紧张关系。他还参与攻赵、攻燕。把王翦与其子王贲区分开来很有必要，否则不同将领和战役容易被压缩成一场毫无阻力的统一进程。

dateNote.en: Focus: campaigns of 229–223 BCE. Shiji’s annals and biography arrange some Chu operations differently; 223 BCE marks the conventional completion of the conquest, not an exact date for every episode. No lifespan is inferred.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前229—前223年的战役。《史记》本纪与列传对部分伐楚行动的编排有差异；前223年指通行的灭楚完成年，并非每个情节的精确日期。不推定完整生卒年。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 73

title.en: Qin Shi Huang · Making an empire governable
title.zh: 秦始皇 · 建立帝国的统治秩序

location.label: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

labelI18n.en: Xianyang, Qin court in the Wei valley

summary.en: Ying Zheng inherited the throne of Qin before claiming the new title of First Emperor in 221 BCE. Conquest joined regions with different institutions and traditions; common measures, writing standards and appointed administrators helped the court govern them. Roads, frontier works, palaces and the Lishan burial complex also demanded labor on a vast scale. The Shiji preserves both official inscriptions celebrating order and accounts of punishment and suppression, including restrictions on books. Archaeology adds another perspective through workshops, weapons and the terracotta army. His empire was brief, but later rulers continued to work within institutions Qin had expanded. The imposing material remains invite questions about the people whose labor made imperial power visible.
summary.zh: 嬴政先继承秦王之位，前221年兼并诸侯后，采用“始皇帝”这一新称号。征服将制度和传统各异的地区纳入一体，统一度量、文字规范和任命地方官员，帮助朝廷实施统治。道路、边防、宫殿与骊山陵墓也征用了大量劳力。《史记》一方面保存歌颂秩序的官方刻辞，另一方面记载刑罚与压制，包括对书籍的限制。考古发现的作坊、兵器和兵马俑又提供了另一种视角。秦帝国虽短暂，后来统治者仍沿用并调整秦所扩展的制度。宏大的遗存也促使人追问：是谁的劳动让皇权变得可见？

dateNote.en: Focus: accession as Qin king in 247 BCE through death in 210 BCE, rather than a full lifespan. Regnal year 1 began in 246 BCE; accession year and first regnal year are distinct.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前247年继秦王位至前210年去世，不作完整生平年表。秦王政元年为前246年，即位之年与元年需要区分。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 6

title.en: Meng Tian · Armies, walls and roads
title.zh: 蒙恬 · 军队、边墙与道路

labelI18n.zh: 秦朝北部边疆的九原地区

summary.en: Meng Tian belonged to a military family serving Qin across generations. After the conquests, he commanded forces on the northern frontier, where campaigns, settlement and defensive construction reshaped the relationship between the empire and neighboring communities. The walls in his biography followed terrain and connected strategic positions; they were not the later brick monuments often used to illustrate the Great Wall today. He also supervised a direct road between the frontier and the imperial heartland, a project the Shiji describes as unfinished. When the First Emperor died, succession politics reached even this distant command. Meng Tian's removal and death show how vulnerable a frontier army remained to decisions made inside the court.
summary.zh: 蒙恬出身于几代为秦效力的军事家族。兼并诸侯后，他统率北疆军队，战争、移民和防御设施改变了帝国与周边群体的关系。传记中的边墙依山川地势修筑、连接战略位置，并非今天常用来表现长城的后世砖石建筑。他还主持连接边疆与帝国腹地的直道工程，《史记》明确说该工程尚未完成。始皇帝去世后，继位斗争延伸到远方军营。蒙恬被撤换并死亡，说明边疆军队即使掌握兵力，仍受到宫廷决定的支配。

dateNote.en: Focus: service from the Qi campaign in 221 BCE through death in 210 BCE. The northern campaign and road are anchored by Shiji chapter 6’s regnal chronology; the road is not described as completed.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前221年伐齐至前210年去世。北征与直道日期结合《史记》卷六的在位年纪年，不把直道写成已全部完工。

sources.evidenceNote: Meng family biography supports northern command, terrain-based defensive works, the unfinished direct road and succession-related death.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 蒙氏传记支持北疆统兵、因地制宜的边防工程、尚未完成的直道及继位危机中的死亡。

title.en: Xiang Yu · Victory without a lasting settlement
title.zh: 项羽 · 胜利之后的秩序难题

summary.en: Xiang Yu rose with the rebellions that dismantled Qin rule. His victory at Julu made him a leading commander, but defeating an empire did not settle who would inherit it. In 206 BCE he distributed kingdoms among allies and rivals and established his own center at Pengcheng. The arrangement soon unraveled as excluded rulers, competing ambitions and warfare fractured the coalition. Liu Bang's forces eventually surrounded him at Gaixia. Sima Qian turned his final defeat into one of the Shiji's most memorable narratives, complete with speeches and songs. Those literary scenes should be read alongside the harder political question: why military predominance could not produce a durable agreement among the victors.
summary.zh: 项羽随推翻秦统治的起义而崛起，巨鹿之战使他成为主要军事统帅。然而打败一个帝国，并没有解决由谁继承其统治的问题。前206年，他在盟友与竞争者之间分封诸王，以彭城为自己的中心。被排斥者的不满、各方野心和持续战争，很快破坏了这一安排。后来刘邦一方的军队在垓下围住项羽。司马迁把他的最终失败写成《史记》中格外鲜明的叙事，包含言辞与歌声。阅读这些文学场景时，也应追问实际的政治难题：军事优势为何没能转化为胜利者之间持久的协议？

dateNote.en: Focus: uprising in 209 BCE to defeat and death in 202 BCE. Civil-year labels follow the Qin–Han sequence; the final speeches and songs are transmitted literary testimony.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前209年起兵至前202年败亡。公元纪年依秦汉之际的通行序列；临终言辞与歌唱作为传世文学性记述呈现。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 7
sources.evidenceNote: Supports the uprising, Julu, division into kingdoms, Pengcheng center, coalition failures and Gaixia defeat; vivid final scenes are attributed to the historian’s narrative.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持起兵、巨鹿、分封、彭城中心、联盟破裂及垓下败亡；末路场景归于史家的叙事。

description.en: Xiang Yu joined Xiang Liang’s uprising against Qin.
description.zh: 项羽参与项梁领导的反秦起兵。

description.en: Victory over Qin forces strengthened his standing among the rebel armies.
description.zh: 战胜秦军提高了他在反秦诸军中的地位。

title.en: Liu Bang · Building a winning coalition
title.zh: 刘邦 · 建立能够取胜的联盟

summary.en: Liu Bang's rise began in local office and rebellion, not in an established royal court. The Shiji follows his force from Pei into Qin's heartland and then through a war in which allies repeatedly changed sides. Victory required commanders, supplies and agreements about who would receive conquered territory. Zhang Liang's advice and Han Xin's campaigns belonged to that larger coalition. In 202 BCE Liu Bang became emperor and shifted his political center toward the Chang'an region. The settlement combined imperial administration with kingdoms granted to powerful allies and relatives. Subsequent conflict over those kingdoms shows that founding the Han dynasty was a continuing negotiation over power, rather than a single moment when conquest became stable government.
summary.zh: 刘邦的崛起始于地方职务和起兵，而非现成的王室宫廷。《史记》记述他从沛县进入秦的腹地，随后卷入一场盟友不断改换阵营的战争。取胜需要将领、供给，也需要对征服所得作出分配承诺。张良的谋划与韩信的战役，都是这一大联盟的组成部分。前202年，刘邦称帝，并将政治中心转向长安地区。新秩序把帝国行政与分封给功臣、宗亲的王国结合起来。围绕这些王国的后续冲突表明，汉朝的建立是一场持续的权力协商，而非征服突然变成稳定统治的单一时刻。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 209–202 BCE rise to imperial power. The inherited birth date is omitted; the interval does not claim to cover the entire reign.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前209—前202年取得帝位的过程。不采用原目录的出生年，此区间也不表示完整在位时期。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 8
sources.evidenceNote: Pei uprising, entry into Qin, Chu–Han coalition negotiations, imperial accession and the move toward Guanzhong; myths of birth and exact army totals are excluded.

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 张良关于分配利益的建议支持联盟形成的叙述，而非将胜利归于一位统帅。

description.en: Local supporters made Liu Bang a leader in the movement against Qin.
description.zh: 地方支持者拥立刘邦，加入反秦行动。

description.en: The post-Qin division assigned him Han; renewed war soon challenged that settlement.
description.zh: 秦亡后的分封使他成为汉王，新的战争很快冲击这一安排。

description.en: Coalition victory over Xiang Yu allowed Liu Bang to take the imperial title and reorganize territorial rewards.
description.zh: 联盟战胜项羽后，刘邦称帝并重新分配封国。

title.en: Han Xin · A commander and the politics of reward
title.zh: 韩信 · 将领与封赏政治

summary.en: Han Xin's career exposes the bargain at the heart of Liu Bang's coalition. His armies defeated rival forces in the north and east, while his ruler needed him to keep men and territory committed to the wider war. The Shiji's famous battlefield narratives emphasize surprise, timing and an opponent's mistaken expectations. They also describe bargaining: after conquering Qi, Han Xin requested a royal title. Once Xiang Yu was defeated, his independent position became harder to sustain. Transferred to Chu, then reduced to marquis, he was eventually killed on an accusation of rebellion arranged through Empress Lü and Xiao He. The surviving account is a Han court narrative; the accusation should not be confused with independently preserved trial evidence.
summary.zh: 韩信的经历揭示了刘邦联盟中的利益交换。他的军队在北方和东方击败对手，刘邦则需要他继续把兵力和地盘投入共同战争。《史记》著名的战场叙事强调突然性、时机和对手的误判，也写到政治议价：攻取齐地后，韩信要求王号。项羽被击败后，他的独立地位越来越难以维持。先被徙封为楚王，随后降为淮阴侯，最终在谋反指控下被吕后与萧何设局杀死。现存叙述来自汉代宫廷史学传统；其中的指控，不能等同于独立保存、可逐项核验的审判证据。

dateNote.en: Focus: Han command from 206 BCE to execution in 196 BCE. The inherited birth year is not retained. Dates follow the Han regnal sequence in the annals and biography.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前206年任汉将至前196年被杀。不保留原目录出生年，日期依本纪与列传中的汉王、皇帝纪年。

sources.evidenceNote: Command appointment, Jingxing narrative, Qi kingship, demotion and the reported conspiracy against Empress Lü; accusation is attributed, not independently adjudicated.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持拜将、井陉叙事、齐王封号、降爵与针对吕后的谋反指控；指控按史书叙述标明，不作独立裁判。

description.zh: 刘邦准备挑战秦亡后的分封格局时，韩信进入高级统帅位置。

description.en: The campaign defeated Zhao; its received account made tactical deception central to Han Xin’s reputation.
description.zh: 战役击败赵国，传世叙事使用计成为韩信声名的重要部分。

description.en: A request for a royal title made the allocation of power within the coalition explicit.
description.zh: 请求王号使联盟内部的权力分配问题浮出水面。

description.en: Empress Lü’s court killed Han Xin on a charge of rebellion, according to the transmitted account.
description.zh: 据传世记述，吕后方面以谋反罪杀死韩信。

title.en: Zhang Liang · Advice that held allies together
title.zh: 张良 · 维系联盟的谋略

summary.en: Zhang Liang came from a family that had served the kingdom of Han, which Qin destroyed. The Shiji begins his political story with an unsuccessful attack on the First Emperor, then follows his shift toward advising Liu Bang. His most consequential interventions concerned relationships: avoiding a confrontation that could not be won, recruiting useful allies and making territorial promises credible. The biography credits him with helping resolve the quarrel over Han Xin's kingship and securing allies for the final campaign against Xiang Yu. Later rewards acknowledged counsel as a form of service alongside battlefield achievement. The mysterious old man who gives him a military book belongs to the biography's exemplary storytelling, not a verified account of his education.
summary.zh: 张良的家族曾仕于被秦所灭的韩国。《史记》从一次未遂的刺秦行动写起，随后叙述他转而辅佐刘邦。他的重要建议往往关乎人与人的关系：避免无法取胜的正面对抗，争取可用的盟友，并让领土分配的承诺取得信任。传记把解决韩信王号之争、召集盟军完成对项羽的最后一击，都与他的谋划联系起来。战后的封赏也承认，出谋划策与临阵战功一样，是建国服务的一种。至于授予兵书的神秘老人，则属于传记的劝诫性故事，不能作为其求学过程的可靠记录。

dateNote.en: Focus: the attack conventionally dated 218 BCE to enfeoffment as Marquis of Liu in 201 BCE. No exact birth or death date is asserted.

description.zh: 博浪沙袭击未遂，把张良早期反秦行动与韩国覆亡联系起来。

description.en: Zhang Liang helped Liu Bang negotiate danger and position in the post-Qin settlement.
description.zh: 张良帮助刘邦在秦亡后的格局中应对危险、争取位置。

title.en: Emperor Wen of Han · The work of restraint
title.zh: 汉文帝 · 节制统治的实践

summary.en: Emperor Wen entered the imperial court after the fall of the Lü family's political position. His annals present restraint as an active form of rule: reducing demands, encouraging agriculture and hearing criticism. The account of Chunyu Tiying's petition links one family's predicament to the decision to abolish specified mutilating punishments. It does not mean punishment itself disappeared. Wen also faced rebellion among imperial relatives and conflict along the northern frontier, so the image of frugality coexists with military and dynastic pressures. Sima Qian's portrait helped establish a lasting model of the considerate ruler. Reading the edicts and the historian's praise together lets us distinguish a political ideal from the practical decisions made in its name.
summary.zh: 吕氏政治势力覆亡后，汉文帝由代国进入帝国宫廷。本纪把节制写成一种主动的统治方式：减少征求、劝勉农业、听取批评。淳于缇萦上书的故事，则把一个家庭的困境与废除特定肉刑的决定联系起来，但这并不意味着刑罚本身消失。文帝也面临宗室叛乱和北部边境冲突，因此节俭形象始终与军事、王朝压力并存。司马迁的描写帮助形成了体恤民生的君主典范。把诏令与史家的赞语并读，可以区分政治理想，以及以这一理想为名作出的具体决定。

dateNote.en: Focus: imperial accession in 180 BCE through death in 157 BCE. The 167 BCE reform concerns specified mutilating punishments, not abolition of the penal system.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前180年即帝位至前157年去世。前167年的改革针对特定肉刑，不是废除整个刑罚体系。

title.en: From Dai to the imperial court

description.en: Senior officials invited the king of Dai to become emperor after the Lü crisis.
description.zh: 吕氏危机后，重臣迎立代王为帝。

description.en: The annals connect Tiying’s petition with an order abolishing specified bodily mutilations.
description.zh: 本纪将缇萦上书与下诏废除特定肉刑相联系。

description.zh: 所载遗诏缩减居丧要求，反对增加民众负担的丧葬铺张。

title.en: Emperor Wu of Han · Expansion and the price of empire
title.zh: 汉武帝 · 扩张与帝国的代价

summary.en: Emperor Wu expanded the ambitions of the Han court. Campaigns against the Xiongnu, western embassies and new territorial administrations drew distant societies into changing relations with the empire. At home, the court sponsored classical learning and reorganized ritual authority. These projects required resources. Sima Qian's fiscal history follows the burdens of transport, military rewards and revenue gathering, providing a counterpoint to accounts of imperial achievement. The reign also ended amid violent court conflict, including accusations of witchcraft that destroyed the crown prince's position. His history is therefore best read across institutions and households as well as campaigns: the same government that extended connections could impose heavy demands on those who supplied its soldiers, officials and ceremonies.
summary.zh: 汉武帝扩大了汉廷的政治抱负。对匈奴的战争、向西派遣使团和新设地方行政，使远方社会与帝国建立了不断变化的关系。国内则扶持经典学习，重整祭祀权威。这些行动都需要资源。司马迁的财政史追踪运输、军功赏赐和筹集收入带来的负担，为帝国功业叙事提供另一面。晚年宫廷还发生激烈冲突，巫蛊指控最终摧毁了太子的地位。因此，理解这一时期不能只看战役，还要看制度与家庭：扩展联系的同一个政权，也可能向供养军队、官吏和礼仪的人们提出沉重要求。

dateNote.en: Focus: the reign, 141–87 BCE. The learning milestone refers to the 124 BCE provision for students attached to the erudites; it does not imply an immediate, exclusive ideological monopoly.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前141—前87年的在位时期。学习节点指前124年为博士设置弟子员，不意味着立即形成唯一思想的垄断。

sources.title: Ban Gu and successors, Hanshu, chapter 6

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 财政叙事将战争与工程联系到转输负担、府库耗损及筹款措施。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 123
sources.evidenceNote: Zhang Qian’s missions supply evidence for diplomatic connections and their political aims.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 张骞使行提供外交联系及其政治目标的证据。

description.zh: 刘彻继承已有的汉朝君主制度，开始长期统治。

description.en: The court expanded the institutional support for learning and recruitment through classical study.
description.zh: 朝廷扩大学习机构，通过经典研究培养、选用人才。

description.en: Witchcraft accusations and armed conflict at Chang’an ended in the deaths of the crown prince and empress.
description.zh: 巫蛊指控及长安的武装冲突，最终导致太子与皇后死亡。

description.en: The emperor appointed the young Liu Fuling as heir shortly before his death.
description.zh: 皇帝去世前立年幼的刘弗陵为继承人。

title.en: Zhang Qian · Diplomacy beyond the frontier
title.zh: 张骞 · 边疆以外的外交

summary.en: Zhang Qian traveled west to seek an alliance, not to inaugurate a commercial road. Detention by the Xiongnu prolonged the mission, and the Yuezhi did not accept the alliance Han wanted. Yet the journey brought the court information about societies beyond its familiar horizon. The Shiji distinguishes places he visited from countries he knew through reports, an essential distinction for mapping his experience. His companion Ganfu and local guides also belong to this history of movement. A later mission to the Wusun multiplied diplomatic contacts through deputy envoys. These journeys joined existing regional connections; they did not create travel or exchange from nothing, and they cannot be reduced to one continuous line called the Silk Road.
summary.zh: 张骞向西出行的目标是寻求联盟，而非开通一条商路。匈奴的拘留延长了使行，月氏也没有接受汉廷期望的联盟。不过，旅程为朝廷带回了熟悉范围之外的社会信息。《史记》区分他亲自到达的地方与通过传闻得知的国家，这是绘制其经历时不可忽略的差别。同行的甘父和地方向导，也属于这段人员流动史。后来出使乌孙时，他派副使前往各地，增多了外交接触。这些旅程连接原有的区域往来，并非从无到有地创造贸易，更不能被压缩成一条名叫“丝绸之路”的连续线。

dateNote.en: Focus: the first departure, dated 139 BCE by UNESCO’s current overview and often 138 BCE elsewhere, through the 119 BCE second mission. The first marker is approximate. Return in 126 BCE is the conventional endpoint of the first mission.
dateNote.zh: 重点为首次出发至前119年的第二次出使。联合国教科文组织现行概述采用前139年，其他年表常用前138年，因此首个节点标为约年；前126年为首次归汉的通常日期。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 123
sources.evidenceNote: Mission objective, detention, Ganfu, visited versus reported societies, unsuccessful alliance and Wusun deputy missions; ancient ethnographic judgments are not adopted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持任务目标、拘留、甘父、亲历与传闻的区分、未成联盟及乌孙副使；不沿用古代民族评价。

description.zh: 首次出发约在前139—前138年，目标是联络月氏共同对抗匈奴。

description.zh: 通行归汉日期标志着长期使行与拘留之后，见闻报告进入朝廷。

title.en: Wei Qing · Command, supply and court favor
title.zh: 卫青 · 统兵、供给与宫廷关系

summary.en: Wei Qing's rise connected a vulnerable household position with access to the imperial court through his sister Wei Zifu. The Shiji nevertheless traces his authority through repeated commands, particularly the seizure of territory around the Yellow River's northern bend and the large campaign beyond the desert. Those operations required transport, horses and coordination among separate forces. Victory also brought captives, new settlements and rewards that tied military success to the emperor's patronage. The biography records disputes over failed subordinate commanders and contrasts Wei Qing's caution with Huo Qubing's increasing prominence. Together these episodes show command as an institutional and political task, not merely a sequence of personal feats. The map uses broad campaign settings rather than a purported exact marching route.
summary.zh: 卫青的崛起，从处境脆弱的家庭成员开始，经由姐姐卫子夫进入皇帝身边。《史记》同时也通过多次统兵说明其权力来源，尤其是夺取黄河北曲一带，以及越过沙漠的大规模远征。这些行动需要运输、马匹和多路部队的协调。胜利又带来俘虏、移民与封赏，把军事成功同皇帝恩遇相联系。传记记述了对失利部将如何处置的争议，也比较卫青的谨慎与霍去病日益上升的地位。这些片段说明，统军既是制度工作，也是政治工作，并非一串个人壮举。地图采用宽泛的战役场景，不声称复原精确行军路线。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 127 BCE northern-bend campaign through the conventional death year, 106 BCE. The selected campaigns are anchored by Yuan-shuo and Yuan-shou regnal years; no birth date is supplied.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前127年河南地战役至通常所定的前106年卒年。所选战役依元朔、元狩纪年定位，不补写出生年。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 111
sources.evidenceNote: Wei Qing’s household background, northern campaigns, appointment as general-in-chief, debates over subordinate responsibility and later death. Ancient casualty and horse totals are not presented as measured statistics.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持卫青家庭背景、北征、任大将军、部将责任争议及晚年去世；不把古代伤亡与马匹数字当作实测统计。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 30
sources.evidenceNote: Documents the fiscal and transport demands accompanying the Shuofang and northern campaigns.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 说明朔方及北方战事所需的财政和运输负担。

description.en: A campaign brought territory within the Yellow River bend under Han control and supported the new Shuofang administration.
description.zh: 战役使黄河曲流内的地区转入汉控制，并支持新设朔方行政。

labelI18n.en: Shuofang region, northern Yellow River bend

description.zh: 又一次远征后，朝廷使其他将领受卫青统属。

labelI18n.zh: 朔方边防统帅部所在区域

description.en: Wei Qing and Huo Qubing led separate major expeditions, exposing the dependence of distant warfare on horses and supplies.
description.zh: 卫青、霍去病分别率领大军远征，显现远方战争对马匹与供给的依赖。

title.en: Huo Qubing · A short career in frontier war
title.zh: 霍去病 · 边疆战争中的短暂生涯

summary.en: Huo Qubing's short career was bound to Emperor Wu's expansion and to the military household of his uncle Wei Qing. The Shiji describes a young commander favored with selected cavalry, rapid operations and substantial rewards. Campaigns in the Hexi corridor and beyond the desert helped alter the balance between Han and Xiongnu powers. They also displaced people and depended on supplies, captured resources and costly losses of horses. The historian's portrait includes criticism of the contrast between the commander's privileged provisions and hungry soldiers. After his death, the imperial funeral used a mound resembling the Qilian mountains to turn a campaign landscape into commemoration. His story links military achievement to the choices about what a court chooses to remember.
summary.zh: 霍去病短暂的仕途与汉武帝的扩张，以及舅父卫青的军事家庭紧密相连。《史记》描写这位年轻统帅拥有优选骑兵，善于快速行动，并得到丰厚封赏。河西与漠北战役改变了汉与匈奴的力量关系，同时也使人口迁移，并依赖供给、缴获资源和代价高昂的马匹消耗。史家的描写还包含批评：将领享有优厚食物，与士卒饥饿形成反差。他去世后，皇帝以形似祁连山的墓冢纪念，将战役景观转化为追怀形式。其故事把军事成就与宫廷选择如何记忆战争联系起来。

dateNote.en: Focus: first recorded successes in 123 BCE through death in 117 BCE. The biography’s age statements are not used to manufacture an exact birthday. Distant campaign locations are regional anchors.
dateNote.zh: 重点为前123年首次所记战功至前117年去世。不用传记年龄推造精确出生日期；远征地点采用区域定位。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 111
sources.evidenceNote: Supports early service, Yuan-shou second-year Hexi campaigns, fourth-year desert expedition, criticism of provisions and sixth-year death and funeral mound.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持早期任职、元狩二年河西战役、四年越漠、对军中供给的批评，以及六年去世与墓冢安排。

description.en: Service with Wei Qing brought Huo Qubing the title Marquis of Champion.
description.zh: 随卫青出征取得战功，获封冠军侯。

description.en: Campaigns and the surrender of Xiongnu leaders changed control and settlement in the corridor.
description.zh: 作战与匈奴首领归降，改变了河西的控制和人口分布。

labelI18n.zh: 河西走廊；以张掖为代表点

description.zh: 与卫青分别率领大军远征，不把最远抵达点绘作定论。

description.en: His funeral mound was shaped, according to the biography, to evoke the Qilian mountains.
description.zh: 据传记记述，墓冢仿祁连山形，以纪念战功。

title.en: Sima Qian · Choosing whose lives to preserve
title.zh: 司马迁 · 选择为谁留下历史

summary.en: Sima Qian inherited a project as well as an office from his father Sima Tan. Travel, court records and transmitted accounts supplied material for a history that moved between rulers, families, institutions and individual lives. Its structure allowed the same conflict to look different from different positions. After defending the defeated general Li Ling, Sima Qian suffered imprisonment and castration. His letter to Ren An explains the wish to finish his work amid humiliation and isolation. The resulting Shiji is indispensable, but its speeches, judgments and carefully arranged scenes are also historical writing shaped by an author. Reading Sima Qian means attending both to the people he preserves and to the choices through which he makes them memorable.
summary.zh: 司马迁从父亲司马谈那里继承的不只是官职，还有一项写史计划。旅行、宫廷档案与传闻，为他在君主、家族、制度和个人之间展开历史提供材料。这种结构使同一场冲突可以从不同立场被观察。为战败的李陵辩护后，司马迁遭监禁与宫刑。《报任安书》说明，他在屈辱与孤立中仍希望完成著作。《史记》因此不可或缺，但书中的言辞、评价和精心安排的场景，也是作者塑造的历史写作。阅读司马迁，既要关注他保存的人物，也要观察他如何使这些人物令人记住。

dateNote.en: Focus: appointment as Grand Scribe around 109 BCE, the 104 BCE calendar reform and the Li Ling crisis of 99 BCE. The punishment followed that crisis; no precise execution date, completion year or disputed birth/death year is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 重点为约前109年任太史令、前104年历法改革及前99年李陵事件。刑罚发生在事件之后，不断言施刑的精确日期、完稿年或有争议的生卒年。

sources.title: Sima Qian, Shiji, chapter 130
sources.evidenceNote: Autobiographical account of travel, succession to Sima Tan, access to archives, calendar chronology, Li Ling imprisonment and the organization of the work.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 自序支持旅行、继承司马谈职事、利用档案、改历纪年、李陵之祸与全书结构。

sources.title: Ban Gu and successors, Hanshu, chapter 62

description.en: After his father’s death, Sima Qian gained an office with access to the court’s records.
description.zh: 父亲去世后，司马迁担任太史令，得以利用宫廷典籍。

description.zh: 自序把其工作置于太初改历的纪年背景中。

title.en: Wang Mang · Changing institutions in an ancient name
title.zh: 王莽 · 借古制重建秩序

location.label: Chang’an, renamed Chang’an with a different first character under Xin

labelI18n.en: Chang’an, renamed Chang’an with a different first character under Xin

summary.en: Wang Mang replaced the Han ruling house with the Xin dynasty while presenting institutional change as a return to ancient ideals. Land rules, restrictions on buying and selling enslaved people, new currencies and revised titles aimed to reorder society from the court outward. The Hanshu also records confusion, coercive enforcement and the retreat from some measures. Flooding and widening rebellion compounded the regime's difficulties before insurgents entered the capital and killed him. That history was compiled under the restored Han and is openly hostile to his legitimacy. Its detailed policy reports remain valuable, but neither its portrait of a wholly fraudulent ruler nor a modern label such as socialist adequately explains the mix of classicism, ambition and administrative disruption.
summary.zh: 王莽以新朝取代汉室，同时把制度变更解释为恢复古代理想。土地规定、限制买卖奴婢、改铸货币和更换官号，试图从朝廷向外重整社会。《汉书》也记载混乱、强制执行，以及部分措施的退让。洪水与不断扩大的起事进一步加重政权困难，最终起兵者攻入京城，杀死王莽。这部史书写成于复兴后的汉朝，对其合法性抱有明确敌意；其中的政策细节仍有价值。但无论把他写成完全虚伪的篡位者，还是套用现代的“社会主义者”标签，都不足以解释复古思想、政治野心与行政扰动的交织。

dateNote.en: Focus: Xin rule, 9–23 CE. Land and sale restrictions were announced in 9 and relaxed in 12; legislation is distinguished from implementation and does not mean slavery ended.
dateNote.zh: 重点为公元9—23年的新朝统治。9年颁布的土地与买卖限制在12年有所放宽；区分法令与实行，不称奴隶制度已被终结。

sources.title: Ban Gu and successors, Hanshu, chapter 099中
sources.evidenceNote: Xin’s first-year enactments, currency measures, the Yellow River breach and fourth-year relaxation of land and private-dependent sale rules; hostile authorial judgments are identified as such.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 支持新朝元年措施、货币政策、黄河决口，以及四年放宽王田与私属买卖限制；敌对的作者评价与政策记录区分。

title.en: Liu Xiu · Rebuilding Han after civil war
title.zh: 刘秀 · 战乱之后重建汉朝

summary.en: Liu Xiu emerged from the coalitions fighting Wang Mang and became the founder of the Eastern Han. Success at Kunyang helped his rise, but a battle did not automatically make him the uncontested heir to Han authority. He built support in the north, accepted the imperial title in 25 and governed from Luoyang while other rulers still held large territories. His annals combine campaigns with amnesties, administrative consolidation and orders addressing the treatment of enslaved people. The defeat of Gongsun Shu's regime at Chengdu in 36 completed a major stage of reunification, accompanied by violence rather than a peaceful handover. Restoration meant constructing new agreements, offices and loyalties while claiming continuity with an older dynasty.
summary.zh: 刘秀从反抗王莽的联盟中崛起，后来成为东汉的开创者。昆阳胜利帮助他取得地位，但一场战役并未自动使他成为无人争议的汉朝继承者。他在北方建立支持，25年称帝，以洛阳为统治中心，此时其他政权仍控制大片地区。本纪把战争与赦令、行政整合以及有关奴婢待遇的诏令并列记述。36年公孙述政权在成都败亡，完成了重新统一的重要阶段，过程伴随暴力，并非和平交接。“中兴”意味着在宣称继承旧王朝的同时，重新建立协议、官署和忠诚关系。

dateNote.en: Focus: Kunyang in 23 CE through the defeat of the Chengdu regime in 36 CE. This is the consolidation period, not Liu Xiu’s complete reign or lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 重点为23年昆阳之战至36年成都政权败亡。这是权力整合期，不是刘秀完整的在位期或生平。

sources.title: Fan Ye, Hou Hanshu, chapter 1上

description.zh: 刘秀参与击破来攻的新军，提升了在起兵者中的地位。

description.zh: 在其他称帝者仍争夺权力时，他于鄗附近即帝位。

description.zh: 诏令规定杀害奴婢不得减罪，并处理特定虐待行为，但未废除奴隶制度。

description.en: Han armies defeated Gongsun Shu’s regime; the annals also record the subsequent sack and killings.
description.zh: 汉军击败公孙述政权，本纪也记载随后屠掠与杀戮。

title.en: Ban Chao · Negotiating and coercing the oasis states
title.zh: 班超 · 绿洲诸国间的交涉与武力

location.label: Kucha region, Western Regions protectorate setting

labelI18n.en: Kucha region, Western Regions protectorate setting
labelI18n.zh: 西域都护驻地所关联的龟兹地区

summary.en: Ban Chao's career joined writing, diplomacy and force. His biography begins with paid copying in Luoyang before describing campaigns and missions among the oasis states of the Western Regions. Local rulers, rival envoys and regional armies were active participants in these encounters; Han authority depended on shifting alliances as well as threats and violence. Appointment as protector-general formalized a position he had spent years building. The family connection is equally revealing: his sister Ban Zhao petitioned for his return when age and illness made continued service difficult. He reached Luoyang in 102 and died soon afterward. Reading that petition alongside victory reports changes the scale of the story from imperial geography to the cost of prolonged separation.
summary.zh: 班超的仕途连接了书写、外交与武力。传记从他在洛阳佣书供养家人写起，随后记述在西域绿洲诸国的军事行动和使行。当地君主、竞争使者及区域军队都是积极的参与者；汉朝权威依靠变化中的联盟，也依靠威胁与暴力。任西域都护，使他多年经营的地位获得正式承认。家庭联系同样值得关注：年老患病、难以继续任职时，妹妹班昭上书请求让他归来。102年，他抵达洛阳，不久去世。把这封上书与战功报告并读，视野便从帝国地理转向长期骨肉分离的代价。

dateNote.en: Focus: the first Western Regions mission in 73 CE through return and death in 102. The protector-general appointment belongs to 91. The marker represents Kucha, not an exact headquarters footprint or travel route.
dateNote.zh: 重点为73年首次西域使行至102年归来及去世；任都护在91年。地图以龟兹为代表，并非精确官署范围或行程。

title.en: Cao Cao · Grain, armies and the Han court
title.zh: 曹操 · 粮食、军队与汉廷

location.label: Xu, seat of the Han court under Cao Cao

labelI18n.en: Xu, seat of the Han court under Cao Cao
labelI18n.zh: 曹操控制下汉廷所在的许县

summary.en: Cao Cao's power grew from a practical problem: armies could not survive without grain, and authority could not rest on victories alone. In 196 he brought the Han emperor's court to Xu and promoted agricultural colonies to provision his forces. This combined control of the court with a claim to act in the dynasty's name. At Guandu, attacks on Yuan Shao's supplies helped break a rival coalition. Expansion southward then met an alliance led by Sun Quan and Liu Bei at Red Cliffs. The setback left several centers of power in place. Reading his career through food, appointments and alliances makes it more intelligible than treating him as either a flawless strategist or a single villain.
summary.zh: 曹操的权力建立在实际难题之上：军队离不开粮食，权威也不能只靠胜仗。196年，他将汉帝朝廷迁到许县，并推行屯田，为军队提供供给。控制朝廷与以汉朝名义行事，成为相互支撑的政治手段。官渡之战中，攻击袁绍粮运帮助他击破敌方联盟。随后向南扩张，却在赤壁遇到孙权与刘备的联合抵抗，战后多方势力继续并存。从粮食、官职与联盟来理解曹操，比把他写成无所不能的谋略家或单一反派，更能解释其成败。

dateNote.en: Focus: moving the Han court in 196, Guandu in 200 and Red Cliffs in 208. This is a political and military interval, not a lifespan. Ancient troop totals are not reused.
dateNote.zh: 重点为196年迁汉廷、200年官渡及208年赤壁，属于政治军事活动时段，不是完整生卒年。未采用古书兵力总数。

sources.title: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, chapter 1
sources.evidenceNote: Jian’an 1 records the court’s move to Xu and agricultural colonies; Jian’an 5 records Guandu and supply attacks. Pei Songzhi explicitly questions the troop disparity in the received account.

description.zh: 控制朝廷及推行屯田，增强了曹操的政治与供给基础。

description.en: Attacks on Yuan Shao’s grain helped turn a prolonged confrontation into a victory.
description.zh: 袭击袁绍粮运，帮助曹操在长期对峙后取胜。

title.en: Liu Bei · Building a state from shifting alliances
title.zh: 刘备 · 在变化的联盟中建国

summary.en: Liu Bei moved through the fractured Han world by gathering followers and negotiating with stronger powers. Alliance with Sun Quan checked Cao Cao in 208, but cooperation did not settle their competing claims to Jingzhou. In the west, Liu Zhang invited him into Yi Province; their partnership became a war that ended with Liu Bei taking Chengdu. He proclaimed himself emperor in 221, presenting his state as a continuation of Han after Cao Pi's accession. An attack on his former ally Sun Quan then ended in defeat at Yiling. His final arrangements entrusted the young Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang and Li Yan. The career reveals how promises of restoration could coexist with territorial ambition and unstable alliances.
summary.zh: 刘备在汉末分裂的局势中聚集追随者，与强势力量周旋。208年，他与孙权联合阻止曹操，但合作没有解决双方对荆州的竞争。向西发展时，刘璋邀请他进入益州，合作却转为战争，最终由刘备占领成都。221年，曹丕称帝之后，他也登基，以延续汉朝为建国理由。随后进攻旧盟友孙权，却在夷陵战败。临终时，他把年幼继承人刘禅托付给诸葛亮与李严。这段经历显示，恢复旧朝的政治承诺，如何与争夺领土、维持不稳固联盟同时存在。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 208 alliance through death in 223. The narrative follows Sanguozhi’s regnal sequence; claims of remote Han ancestry are not independently verified here.
dateNote.zh: 重点为208年联盟至223年去世，依《三国志》在位年顺序编排；不把遥远的汉室世系主张视为已独立证实。

sources.title: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, chapter 32
sources.evidenceNote: Supports the Red Cliffs alliance, invitation and conquest of Yi, 221 proclamation, 222 defeat and 223 deathbed arrangements. The imperial proclamation is a political claim, not proof of unanimous consent.

title.en: Sun Quan · Holding the lower Yangzi together
title.zh: 孙权 · 经营长江下游

location.label: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang

labelI18n.en: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang
labelI18n.zh: 吴国政治中心建业，后称建康

summary.en: Sun Quan inherited his brother Sun Ce's position in 200, but the territories and commanders he inherited did not form a settled kingdom. Building authority meant retaining experienced officers, negotiating with local elites and using force against communities beyond effective control. At Red Cliffs, he backed resistance to Cao Cao and cooperation with Liu Bei. Their alliance later fractured over Jingzhou, before further diplomacy restored cooperation against Wei. Sun Quan's imperial proclamation in 229 gave these regional arrangements a dynastic name: Wu. His story shifts attention from a single famous battle to the political work that kept a southern state operating among powerful neighbors, competing officials and communities with their own interests.
summary.zh: 200年，孙权继承兄长孙策的地位，但接手的土地与将领并不构成一个已经稳定的王国。他需要留住有经验的军政人员，与地方精英合作，也对控制范围之外的群体动用武力。赤壁战前，他支持抵抗曹操，并与刘备联合。后来双方因荆州决裂，又通过外交重新合作抗魏。229年称帝，使这些区域性的经营拥有“吴”的王朝名号。他的经历把视线从一场著名战役移向持续的政治工作：如何在强邻、相互竞争的官员及各有诉求的地方群体之间，维持一个南方政权。

dateNote.en: Focus: succession to Sun Ce in 200 through imperial accession in 229. Ancient Wuchang refers to the Ezhou region, not the modern Wuhan district of that name.
dateNote.zh: 重点为200年继孙策至229年称帝。此处古武昌指今鄂州一带，并非今日武汉同名城区。

title.en: Zhuge Liang · Administration behind a strategist’s fame
title.zh: 诸葛亮 · 谋略名声背后的治理

summary.en: Zhuge Liang's work joined diplomacy, taxation, military supply and political counsel. He helped secure cooperation with Sun Quan, then supported Liu Bei's government at Chengdu. After Liu Bei died, he became the central administrator under Liu Shan and pursued campaigns intended to challenge Wei. Supply remained a persistent problem: the final campaign included soldiers farming near the Wei River to sustain a longer presence. The first northern expedition had already shown the consequences of failed command at Jieting. His memorials connect loyalty with responsibility for results. The annotated Sanguozhi also rejects some spectacular tales later attached to him. The historical official is most interesting where plans encounter distance, resources and other people's decisions.
summary.zh: 诸葛亮的工作横跨外交、赋税、军粮与政治劝谏。他帮助促成与孙权的合作，又在成都支持刘备政权。刘备死后，他成为刘禅朝廷的主要执政者，并通过北方战役挑战魏国。供给始终是难题，最后一次出兵时，他安排军士在渭水附近耕作，以便长期驻扎。此前第一次北伐的街亭失利，已经显露指挥失误的后果。他的表文把忠诚与承担成败责任联系起来。《三国志》注还驳斥了某些附会于他的神奇故事。把计划放回距离、资源和其他人的选择之中，才更能看到这位历史人物。

dateNote.en: Focus: regency after Liu Bei’s death in 223 through the final campaign and death in 234. Dates follow Zhangwu 3 and Jianxing 6 and 12; no fictional stratagem supplies a milestone.
dateNote.zh: 重点为223年刘备死后辅政至234年最后出兵及去世。依章武三年、建兴六年与十二年纪年，不以虚构计谋填补节点。

sources.evidenceNote: Supports 223 regency, the 228 Jieting reversal, 234 Wuzhang campaign, military farming and death. Pei Songzhi tests and rejects chronologically incompatible anecdotes, including the empty-fort story.

description.zh: 刘备去世后，诸葛亮在刘禅朝廷中承担主要政务。

title.en: Guan Yu · Loyalty and a contested frontier
title.zh: 关羽 · 忠诚与争夺中的边地

summary.en: Guan Yu's recorded career was shaped by divided loyalties and the strategic importance of Jingzhou. Captured by Cao Cao in 200, he served briefly in Cao's army and killed Yan Liang at Baima before returning to Liu Bei. Later he commanded the territory left behind when Liu Bei established himself in the west. His offensive toward Fancheng in 219 gained an unexpected advantage when floods overwhelmed an opposing army. Yet Sun Quan's forces struck at his rear, took Jiangling and broke his army's cohesion. Guan Yu was captured and killed. The surviving biography supplies a compact history of service, military success and collapse; famous scenes from later storytelling should not silently replace that sequence.
summary.zh: 关羽的文献生涯与效忠对象的变化、荆州的战略地位紧密相连。200年，他被曹操俘获，短暂为其作战，在白马杀颜良，随后返回刘备身边。刘备在西方建立根据地后，关羽负责留下的荆州地区。219年进攻樊城时，洪水冲垮敌军，使他一度取得优势。然而孙权军袭击后方，夺取江陵，瓦解了其部队的凝聚力。关羽最终被俘并遭杀害。传世列传提供的是一段紧凑的效力、胜利与崩溃史，后世讲述中的著名场景不应在没有说明的情况下代替这一顺序。

dateNote.en: Focus: 200–219. The 214 Jingzhou command follows Liu Bei’s conquest of Yi; the biography dates the last campaign to Jian’an 24.
dateNote.zh: 重点为200—219年。214年荆州统兵承接刘备取得益州；最后战役在传记中系于建安二十四年。

sources.title: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, chapter 36
sources.evidenceNote: Guan Yu’s biography records 200 service at Baima, later Jingzhou responsibility, the 219 flood, rear attack and death. Its unnamed physician is not identified as Hua Tuo; no Peach Garden oath or Five Passes episode is imported.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 关羽传记200年白马作战、后来的荆州职责、219年洪水、后方遇袭与死亡。未把未具名医师认定为华佗，也未引入桃园结义或过五关情节。

sources.title: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, chapter 32

title.en: Zhou Yu · Coalition command on the Yangzi
title.zh: 周瑜 · 长江上的联军指挥

summary.en: Zhou Yu's command depended on cooperation as well as tactical decisions. A companion of Sun Ce, he later helped sustain Sun Quan's authority. When Cao Cao moved south, Zhou Yu argued that distance, disease and unfamiliar river warfare limited the invading army. At Red Cliffs he served alongside Cheng Pu and allied with Liu Bei; the biography credits Huang Gai with proposing the fire attack. Victory did not finish the campaign. Fighting around Jiangling continued against Cao Ren, and Zhou Yu was wounded before the city changed hands. These linked operations reveal a war of logistics, officers and coalition interests. They also make room for the many participants obscured when the battle is reduced to one brilliant hero.
summary.zh: 周瑜的指挥既依靠战术，也依靠合作。他早年与孙策相交，后来支持孙权维持统治。曹操南下时，周瑜指出远距离作战、疾病和不熟悉水战对来军的限制。赤壁之战，他与程普共同统兵，并与刘备合作；列传把提出火攻之计的功劳归给黄盖。胜利没有结束整个战役，在江陵与曹仁的战斗仍持续进行，周瑜受伤后又继续督战，直到城池易手。把这些行动连起来，可以看到粮运、将领和联盟利益共同构成的战争，也让被单一英雄叙事遮蔽的参与者重新出现。

dateNote.en: Focus: return to Sun Ce’s service in 198, Red Cliffs in 208 and the Jiangling settlement in 209. No uncertain death-site identification is used as a map point.
dateNote.zh: 重点为198年重归孙策、208年赤壁及209年江陵战后安排。不以有争议的去世地点作地图定位。

sources.title: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, chapter 54
sources.evidenceNote: Zhou Yu section gives Jian’an 3 service, resistance arguments, shared command, Huang Gai’s proposal and the Jiangling fighting. Embedded speeches are treated as the historian’s account.

title.en: Lu Xun · Patience, command and coercion
title.zh: 陆逊 · 等待、指挥与强制

location.label: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang

labelI18n.en: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang
labelI18n.zh: 吴国政治中心建业，后称建康

summary.en: Lu Xun's career connects the expansion of Wu with the demands it placed on local society. His early commands drew people into military service and registered households; the biography even preserves criticism that he took people unjustly. In 219 he helped Lü Meng prepare the seizure of Guan Yu's rear. Against Liu Bei in 222, he resisted impatient colleagues, waited for an opportunity and used fire to break the enemy camps. A further victory over Wei at Shiting strengthened his standing. Military achievement rested on managing fellow commanders and drawing resources from the countryside. This Lu Xun is the third-century general, whose name and historical setting should remain distinct from the modern writer Lu Xun.
summary.zh: 陆逊的经历把吴国扩张与地方社会承担的要求联系起来。早期统兵时，他将人口纳入军役和编户，传记甚至保存了他侵取民众的批评。219年，他协助吕蒙准备袭取关羽后方。222年对抗刘备时，他压住将领急战的要求，等待时机，再用火攻击破敌营。后来在石亭击败魏军，又巩固了其地位。军功依赖对同僚的协调，也依赖从乡村取得的资源。此处的陆逊是三世纪将领，姓名的英文拼写虽与现代作家鲁迅相近，人物和时代必须保持区分。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 219 Jingzhou operation, Yiling in 222 and Shiting in 228. These dated commands replace an unverified inherited lifespan.
dateNote.zh: 重点为219年荆州行动、222年夷陵及228年石亭，采用有纪年的统兵活动，不沿用未经核实的生卒年。

sources.evidenceNote: Supports coerced recruitment and registration, Chunyu Shi’s criticism, the Jian’an 24 Jingzhou operation, Huangwu 1 Yiling and Huangwu 7 victory over Cao Xiu.

description.zh: 外交往来与隐蔽准备帮助吴军夺取关羽根据地。

description.en: Lu Xun delayed the decisive attack before breaking Liu Bei’s camps.
description.zh: 陆逊等待时机，再发动决定性攻击，击破刘备营垒。

title.en: Sima Yi · From Wei commander to family power
title.zh: 司马懿 · 从魏臣到家族权力

summary.en: Sima Yi served the Cao-Wei state before his family displaced it. Campaigns and court appointments gave him authority across military and civil affairs. In 238 he conquered the Gongsun regime in Liaodong; the Jin history records extensive killing after Xiangping fell, alongside its praise of his generalship. The decisive move at the center came in 249, when he seized control while Cao Shuang accompanied the emperor to the Gaoping tombs. Promises of retirement were followed by executions. Further repression secured his position before his death in 251. He did not reign as emperor during his lifetime. The imperial title used by the Jinshu belongs to the dynasty his descendants later founded and shapes its retrospective account.
summary.zh: 司马懿先为曹魏效力，后来其家族取而代之。战役与朝廷任命使他掌握横跨军政的权力。238年，他征服辽东公孙氏政权；《晋书》在赞扬统兵能力的同时，也记载襄平陷落后的大规模杀戮。249年，曹爽陪皇帝谒高平陵时，他在京城夺取控制权。许以免官退居的安排，随后转成诛杀。进一步镇压反对力量后，他于251年去世。司马懿生前并未当皇帝，《晋书》所用帝号来自其后人建立王朝后的追尊，也影响了史书回顾其生涯的方式。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 238 Liaodong campaign, 249 coup and death in 251. Jinshu’s posthumous imperial nomenclature is distinguished from his lifetime offices.
dateNote.zh: 重点为238年辽东战役、249年政变及251年去世。区分《晋书》追尊帝号与生前官职。

sources.title: Jinshu, chapter 1
sources.evidenceNote: Jingchu 2 gives the Liaodong campaign and killings after Xiangping; Jiaping 1 records the coup and executions; Jiaping 3 records death and later posthumous titles. Praise and portent stories are not adopted as independent evidence.

description.en: The fall of Xiangping ended Gongsun rule and was followed by killings recorded in the dynastic history.
description.zh: 襄平陷落结束公孙氏统治，正史同时记载随后的杀戮。

description.en: Sima Yi took control in Luoyang while Cao Shuang was outside the capital.
description.zh: 曹爽离京时，司马懿在洛阳夺权。

description.en: He died while still a Wei minister; imperial honors came later under his descendants.
description.zh: 他去世时仍为魏臣，帝号来自后人的追尊。

title.en: Wang Xizhi · A gathering preserved through copies
title.zh: 王羲之 · 由摹本延续的雅集

summary.en: Wang Xizhi joined literary friendship and official service in the Eastern Jin world. His most celebrated work is associated with a gathering at the Orchid Pavilion in 353, where poetry and wine prompted reflection on pleasure, change and mortality. The preface became a model for calligraphers across later centuries, but the surviving objects belong to a history of copying, collecting, engraving and attribution. They should not all be described as his original handwriting. His biography also records administrative concerns and a bitter dispute with Wang Shu, followed by a formal oath to leave office in 355. Reading the gathering beside that withdrawal brings artistic sociability and the pressures of elite public life into the same frame.
summary.zh: 王羲之的生活把东晋士人的文学交游与官职相连。与他联系最深的作品，来自353年的兰亭聚会：诗与酒引出对欢乐、变化和生命终结的思考。《兰亭序》后来成为书法学习的典范，但今天所见实物属于摹写、收藏、刻石与鉴定的漫长历史，不能一律称为王羲之亲笔原迹。传记还记载他的行政关切，与王述的冲突，以及355年辞官后向父母墓所作的誓言。将雅集与退职并读，可以把艺术交往和士族公共生活的压力放回同一幅历史画面。

dateNote.en: Focus: the Orchid Pavilion gathering in 353 and the resignation oath dated Yonghe 11 (355). Two documented events are used; disputed or reconstructed lifespan dates are omitted.
dateNote.zh: 重点为353年兰亭雅集及永和十一年（355）的辞官誓言，仅使用两个有据事件，不填入有争议或推算的生卒年。

title.en: Xie An · Keeping a court together in crisis
title.zh: 谢安 · 危局中维系朝廷

location.label: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang

labelI18n.en: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang
labelI18n.zh: 吴国政治中心建业，后称建康

summary.en: Xie An's reputation for cultivated withdrawal did not keep him outside government. After years among literary companions around Kuaiji, he entered service and became central to the Eastern Jin court. His task involved balancing the imperial family, powerful ministers and commanders with regional bases. When Former Qin invaded in 383, Xie Shi, Xie Xuan and other generals fought the campaign while Xie An coordinated from the political center. The Jinshu's famous story of his calm reaction to victory is a crafted portrait of composure, not a direct view into his thoughts. Rivalries persisted after the danger passed. His career shows that preserving a regime required managing relationships as well as winning a battle.
summary.zh: 谢安以退隐风雅著称，却并未始终置身政治之外。他早年在会稽一带与文人交游，后来出仕，逐渐成为东晋朝廷的核心人物。他需要在皇族、权臣和拥有地方军力的将领之间维持平衡。383年前秦入侵时，谢石、谢玄等将领在前线作战，谢安则在政治中心协调。《晋书》中得胜仍从容下棋的著名故事，是塑造镇定形象的叙事，并非对其内心的直接观察。危机解除后，权力竞争仍在继续。他的经历说明，维持政权既需要战场胜利，也需要处理人与人之间的关系。

dateNote.en: Focus: appointment as chief deputy in the Secretariat in 373, the Fei River campaign in 383 and death in 385. Annals supply the dates; the biography supplies political context.
dateNote.zh: 重点为373年任尚书仆射、383年淝水战役及385年去世。本纪提供纪年，列传提供政治背景。

sources.evidenceNoteZh: 宁康元年记373年任职，太元八年记383年前线诸将，太元十年记385年去世。

description.zh: 桓温去世后，谢安任尚书仆射，进入行政中枢。

title.en: Tao Yuanming · The work of returning home
title.zh: 陶渊明 · 归田并非无事

summary.en: Tao Yuanming, also known as Tao Qian, made withdrawal from office a subject of lasting literary interest. Returning Home presents the decision through familiar things: children at the door, trees in a garden, a boat and the coming agricultural season. Yet the surviving biography and letters also speak of illness, poverty and worry about children carrying water and gathering fuel. Rural life was a choice with material consequences, not effortless escape. Later painters returned to the poem when considering their own relations with official power. The well-known account of refusing to bow for a small salary belongs to his biographical tradition; it should not crowd out the more searching conversation about dependence, work and dignity in his writing.
summary.zh: 陶渊明又名陶潜，把辞官归田写成了长期引人思考的文学主题。《归去来兮辞》用门前的孩子、园中的树、行舟与将临的农时来呈现这一决定。然而传记与书信也谈到疾病、贫困，以及孩子挑水取薪的劳苦。乡居是带来实际后果的选择，并不是毫不费力的逃离。后来的画家反复表现这篇辞赋，借以思考自己与官场的关系。“不为五斗米折腰”的故事属于其传记传统，却不应遮盖作品中关于依赖、劳动和尊严的更深入讨论。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 405 resignation and Returning Home, through death in 427. Two dated anchors are used; literary scenes are not turned into separate calendar events.
dateNote.zh: 重点为405年辞官与《归去来兮辞》至427年去世，使用两个有据日期，不把文学场景拆成独立纪年。

sources.title: Shen Yue, Songshu, chapter 93
sources.evidenceNote: Tao Qian section preserves the resignation tradition, Returning Home, letters concerning poverty and children’s labor, and death in Yuanjia 4. Literary first-person scenes are read as writing, not a literal daily log.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 陶潜部分保存辞官传统、《归去来兮辞》、谈贫困与子女劳作的书信，以及元嘉四年卒年。文学第一人称场景作为作品阅读，不作逐日日志。

title.en: Liu Yu · Restoration becomes a new dynasty
title.zh: 刘裕 · 恢复旧朝与建立新朝

location.label: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang

labelI18n.en: Jianye, Wu political center; later Jiankang
labelI18n.zh: 吴国政治中心建业，后称建康

summary.en: Liu Yu first built his authority as a commander acting in the name of the Eastern Jin. In 404 his coalition rose against Huan Xuan and recovered the capital for the displaced dynasty. Subsequent campaigns increased his control over soldiers, appointments and territory. In 417 his generals captured Chang'an and ended Later Qin, but the northern gains proved difficult to hold after he returned east. The surviving history records the loss of the region in the following year. In 420 Liu Yu replaced the Jin emperor and founded the Liu-Song dynasty. The language of restoration had become the language of dynastic succession. His record connects military achievement with the problem of turning a personal command into a governing house.
summary.zh: 刘裕最初以东晋名义统兵，逐渐建立权势。404年，他与盟友起兵反对桓玄，为被取代的晋朝夺回都城。此后的战役扩大了他对军队、官职与土地的控制。417年，麾下将领攻取长安，结束后秦，但他东归后，北方所得难以守住，史书记载次年关中失守。420年，刘裕取代晋帝，建立刘宋。恢复旧朝的语言转成了王朝更替的语言。他的经历将军事成就与另一道难题联系起来：如何把个人统兵的权力转为一个统治家族的制度。

dateNote.en: Focus: the 404 uprising, Chang’an campaign in 417 and accession in 420. Liu-Song is the fifth-century dynasty, distinct from the Song founded in 960.
dateNote.zh: 重点为404年起兵、417年长安战事及420年称帝。刘宋为五世纪王朝，与960年建立的宋朝不同。
